errors.item: opponent's Card of the Game display
errors.says: independent check: frame at 170 displays owner Hydreigon; REVIEW.md: opponent card of the game is Magnemite based on its attack, not a separately verified result display
errors.truth: t=170-171 shows the page 'Your opponent's cards' with Card of the Game = Magnemite; Hydreigon is the owner's page at t=168-169. X's field value (Magnemite) is right, its support and its correction of G are wrong.
